content:
alisa: Heads-up — customer-request for a per-region surge protection strategy + A/B slices for our next rollout. Need a short plan for Friday sync.

sandeep: +1. are we talking feature-flag gating, autoscale limits, or throttling at router?

matt: Probably all three. My proposal: small canary -> regional slice -> auto-fallback to cheaper model + reject surge above X rps.

alisa: Agree. constraints: enterprise customers want zero 5xx, product teams want 80% of traffic on new variant within 24h.

janet: For the 80% goal we need safe ramp steps and automatic rollback triggers. What rollback signals? error rate, latency p95, token cost spike?

kevin: From infra: prioritize error rate > 0.5% for 5xx, p95 latency +200ms over baseline, and memory OOMs. Also track GPU queue depth.

matt: Let's draft thresholds:
- canary: 0.5% traffic region A for 30m
- stage-1: 5% for 2h
- stage-2: 25% for 6h
- regional-open: 100% if metrics stable for 24h
Fallback: immediate split to previous model variant or route to hosted fallback with 5s timeout.

alisa: That looks good. For customers with reserved capacity we should skip automated fallback unless they opt-in — flag `allow_auto_fallback`.

janet: Add kill-switch path: global flag `rollout.stop` that eng-oncall can flip. Must be instrumented in the routing layer and visible in console.

eng-oncall: Can we ensure flips propagate <15s? Last time it took ~45s in one zone.

kevin: We'll add pub/sub invalidate event and an immediate short-circuit in the proxy. Should be <=10s in normal case. Needs a small infra change.

matt: Also want experiment slices for A/B metrics. Proposal: cohorts by customer size (dev, startup, enterprise) + random 10% control within each cohort. Keep sample sizes stable by region.

alisa: Important: product-metrics teams want deterministic seed for randomization per customer id so experiments don't drift on retries.

janet: Ops note: for canaries that touch embeddings or rerank, we should shadow traffic for 24h prior to canary to catch regressions in quality. Shadowing should not count towards billing.

kevin: We'll add a `shadow=true` flag route. Might add 5-10% extra router CPU. Fine.

deploy-bot: deploy: rollout-config v2.3 created by matt at 1715001270

matt: sample config snippet (for the doc):
```
rollout {
  id: "geo-surge-1"
  canary { region: "eu-west-1" traffic: 0.5 duration: "30m" }
  stages: [ { traffic: 5 duration: "2h" }, { traffic: 25 duration: "6h" } ]
  thresholds: { error_rate: 0.005 p95_latency_ms_delta: 200 }
  fallback: { kind: "variant", id: "stable-v3" }
  flags: { allow_auto_fallback: false, shadow: true }
}
```

alisa: Nice. For launch criteria checklist (short):
- define metrics & thresholds (done)
- infra rollback <15s (kevin)
- console visibility (janet)
- experiment seed & cohorts (matt)
- customer opt-in matrix (product)

janet: Who owns the console dashboard for this? I can add widgets but need the metric names and tag keys.

matt: metric names: `request.error_rate`, `request.p95_latency_ms`, `gpu.queue_depth`, `model.token_cost`. Tag by `region`, `rollout_id`, `variant`, `customer_tier`.

alisa: Customer asks: enterprise customers need SLA carve-outs for fallback. I'll coordinate contract text.

kevin: One more infra constraint: on regions with spot-backed fleets we cap stage-2 to 50% to avoid eviction cascades. Document that as `region_constraints`.

matt: Good call. We'll include region constraints table in the rollout doc.

alisa: Action items:
- matt: put full draft rollout YAML and A/B cohort plan in the shared doc by EOD Thurs
- kevin: infra change for <10s kill-switch propagation, estimate by EOD Thu
- janet: console widgets & alert rules draft by Fri AM
- sandeep: summarize customer opt-in matrix and reserved-capacity behavior
- eng-oncall: be on-call during canary window

eng-oncall: noted. I'll create a runbook stub and add to oncall rotation.

deploy-bot: deploy: rollout-config v2.3 saved to deployments/geo-surge-1 at 1715001282 :white_check_mark:

alisa: Thanks all — let's review Fri 10am. :thumbsup:

matt: Added doc link: https://redwood.co/drive/rollouts/geo-surge-1 (draft)

kevin: minor comment in doc about spot regions.

sandeep: quick Q — what about pricing implications if we fallback to hosted cheaper model? need product signoff on cost pass-through.

alisa: I'll loop in finance if we finalize that fallback path.

janet: All good from my side. I'll wire up alerts to both #eng-oncall and #product.
